title: Tools
description: Tools landing — linker cards to import, export, site-health, and other admin utilities.

documentation.purpose: Landing screen for the Tools navigation entry. Renders a 2-column grid of cards, one per available tool. Each card opens either a sibling shell app (Site Health → `#/site-health`) or a wp-admin page (Import, Export, Export Personal Data, Erase Personal Data — all four still link out to `import.php`, `export.php`, etc. because the wp-admin equivalents have no REST surface and no v2 native equivalent yet).

reads.purpose: Base URL for legacy wp-admin links.

states.renders: Header + 2-column card grid with five tool cards.

interactions.trigger: Click Open on a tool card with `appId`
Click Open on a tool card with `legacy`
interactions.effect: `window.location.href = adminUrl + tool.legacy` — leaves the shell into wp-admin.

constraints.note: Import / Export / Personal Data Export / Personal Data Erase have no REST coverage and no native v2 app yet. Their cards navigate out to wp-admin and lose the user's place in the shell.
Tools list is hard-coded — plugins cannot inject tool cards. A future iteration may add a filter / registry once the surface stabilizes.
